basic_info.description: Upper floor one bedroom, one bathroom residence at the Beacon in San Francisco's Mission Bay featuring sweeping views of the bay and city skyline. The open concept floor plan with spacious living/dining room with beautiful wood flooring and incredible views. The modern kitchen features tile floors, ample cabinetry and stainless appliances including electric range, refrigerator with ice and water dispensor, dishwasher and microwave. The spacious bedroom has a walk-in closet, room for a desk and exceptional views. Addition large closet adjacent to the bedroom. The large bathroom includes a shower and bathtub, modern vanity and storage closet. In-unit washer/dryer. Ample closets and one-car garage parking available. Elevator Building. Full service resort-style amenities at the Beacon include 24 hour concierge and security, large outdoor swimming pool and sun deck, fully equipped gym, multiple spas, an elegant club room and private dog park. Easy access to CalTrain, Muni, Oracle Park, Mission Bay parks, the Embarcadero and downtown San Francisco
